text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yoo-hoo...
Just dropping by to borrow the sofa for a bit~

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Well~, since it's my day off, I ended up browsing crowdfunding sites way too much~ *yawn*...
choice_data_list: Good grief... keep it in moderation.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yeeep. Sorry to bother ya, Trai-chan.
Wake me up if I'm not up in 15 minutes...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ah, did you wash my blanket for me~?
Thanks a bunch~~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Transcend took a nap, but it seemed she still didn't get quite enough sleep...
